newsitem.title: USA: Abbott, SpectRx in blood-test device pact.
newsitem.headline: Abbott, SpectRx in blood-test device pact.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories Inc and SpectRx Inc signed a research and development and license agreement for a new painless, bloodless technology for monitoring blood glucose, the companies said.
The technology is meant to allow diabetics to check their glucose levels with a hand-held device and without using needles or lancets, they said.

The SpectRx system uses a light beam to open a tiny micropore in the outer, dead layer of skin through which pure interstitial fluid is collected and glucose level readings are made, the companies said.

Under the agreement, Abbott will have exclusive worldwide rights to the technology and co-exclusive rights in Singapore and The Netherlands. The agreement includes milestone, research and development and advance royalty payments.
Specific terms of the deal were not disclosed.
As part of the agreement, Abbott has taken an equity position in privately held SpectRx, the companies said.
